svg.title: Why a 3D window beats stacking depth into channels
svg.desc: Two shapes differ only in the order of their slices: plus, dot, plus versus dot, plus, dot. A 3D window of depth three describes the first with one clause at every depth. A 2D model that stacks all five slices as channels sees the whole depth at once and needs a separate clause for every depth offset.
svg.text: Each slice is a plus or a dot
